unresolved: Text states cadmium, arsenic and mercury were 'absent' in control and test samples 'as per MPC standards' (p. 762) without detection limits or values; not recorded as findings.

Table 2 prints 90Sr 45 Bq/kg for the experimental milk-pumpkin sauce against a stated limit of 20 Bq/kg, while the text says radionuclides were within limits; radionuclides are outside the findings scope.
Sample numbers, instrument, LOD and QA are not reported.
